lines.text: Many learners say: He is the same age with me.
Better: He is the same age as me.
As! He is the same age as me.

data.wrong: He is the same age with me.
data.right: He is the same age as me.
data.memory: He is the same age as me.

quiz.stem: She is the same age ___ me.

native.tip: same のあとは as を使います。with は使いません。
native.caption: “He is the same age with me.”と言っていませんか？😅 「〜と同じ」の「と」につられて with にしがちです。“He is the same age as me.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“as”。“He is the same age as me.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “He is the same age with me.” 😅 The Japanese particle to makes people say with. The natural way is “He is the same age as me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
